notes.title: Version Update 2.8
notes.content:
Version Update
1. Added a mechanism for double item drop rate of events on Saturdays and Sundays.
2. Initially adjusted the Level 7 enhancement effects of Liuguang Equipment (Pojun, Wushuang, Aoyi, Baze, Diwang, Xianzhe).
　For example, Pojun focuses on countering military units, while Xianzhe focuses more on internal affairs.
3. Fixed the bug that prevents auto-battling in Elite 3.
4. Fixed other known bugs

notes.title: Major Update for Three Kingdoms Front
notes.content:
[p][b]Version 2.7 Update Notes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Add 3 Elite Levels
》1. Yellow Turban Rebellion (At the start of the BOSS battle, our side is ambushed and loses 50% armor)
》2. Burning of Luoyang (Each turn, all allies lose 10% troops due to burning)
》3. Heroic Spirit Trial (Each turn, each ally has a 30% chance to be feared (unable to act))[/p][/*][*][p]Increased drop rate of Streamer Gems in Elite Levels, with a probability similar to that of purple-grade materials[/p][/*][*][p]Legions with increased Streamer Gem drop rates in events: Dong Zhuo Legion, Yuan Shao Legion, Sun Quan Legion, Sun Ce Legion, Cao Cao Legion[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted drop rates for certain legions: Green-grade item drop rate reduced by an additional 50% based on the original rate (Sun Ce Legion, Dong Zhuo Legion, Yuan Shao Legion)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted certain legions to no longer drop green-grade items (Sun Quan Legion, Cao Cao Legion)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new crafting recipe: 10 Streamer Gems can be synthesized into 1 Streamer Equipment Chest, which can be opened to randomly obtain 1 Streamer Equipment[/p][/*][*][p]Added VIP display and related bonuses[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed other known issues[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Major version update 01
notes.content:
Update content:
1. Added online rewards, you can get (1 resource box, 50 5-star general fragments, 20 ingots) every day, double the monthly card
2. Added the function of resizing the game screen
3. Added event: pursuit, a total of 10 types of legion forces will appear after the conditions are met (testing phase, only open to some players)
4. Added 100 steam achievements
5. Added the list of generals in the BOSS battle lineup and ordinary battle lineup in each campaign
6. Added the training ground to lock level 0
7. Added the welfare code that supports the available network version
8. Fixed known bugs (purple equipment attributes are wrong, mounts have no speed, ingot redemption content is not refreshed, etc.)

notes.title: 2.3版更新
notes.content:
1.修复后台挂机时无法开启加速
2.修复限购数量上限
3.优化每日月卡，礼包领取异常
1. Fixed the problem that acceleration cannot be turned on when the game is idle in the background
2. Fixed the upper limit of the purchase limit
3. Optimized the daily monthly card and gift package collection abnormalities

notes.title: 2.2版优化1
notes.content:
1.增加全新5星 武将5个（周彻-枪系，赵俨-盾系，祢衡-骑系，花鬘-弓系，李进-枪系 ）
2.增加全新4星 武将9个（邓忠，高沛，牵招 ，贺齐，高干，鲜于辅，国渊，高堂隆，邴原 ）
3.增加图鉴9个（国渊，高沛，邓忠，鄂焕，潘凤，严纲，傅肜，臧洪，刘表）
4.后台最小化时游戏依然可以运行
5.购买礼包类直接显示购买成功后等显示优化
6.修复其他已知问题
